_comment: Negative guard for item 4: Invigorate must NOT auto-fire when it is not lethal. Same board as invigorate_lethal_no_attacker but opp at 4, so the free alt-cost 3 (opp gains 3 -> -3 with Tainted Remedy) leaves opp at 1 -- not a kill, and with no ready attacker there is no other damage. Firing it would gift 3 life for nothing (and, vs a real opponent, hand them tempo). PASS = the engine does NOT fire it and does NOT win by max_turns.
